zh: 漢莎航空集團訂購20架波音737 MAX 10客機，預計2030年代初期交付。
en: Lufthansa Group orders 20 Boeing 737 MAX 10 aircraft with deliveries starting in early 2030s.

zh: 波音評估重工成本超出價值，拆解全新777-9客機。
en: Boeing dismantles a brand-new 777-9 after rework costs exceed the jet's value.

zh: GE航太表示GE9X改進措施不影響波音777X於2027年營運
en: GE Aerospace says GE9X mid-seal fix will not delay Boeing 777X 2027 entry.

zh: 美德州空軍國民警衛隊F-16戰機在密西根州訓練時墜毀，飛官彈射獲救。
en: Texas Air National Guard F-16 crashes during Michigan training flight; pilot ejects safely.

zh: 中國將自9月20日起在以北京為中心300公里範圍內實施空域飛行管制。
en: China will impose a 300 km flight restriction zone around Beijing starting September 20, 2026.

zh: 國籍航空同意取消一線人員名牌全名揭露
en: Taiwan airlines agree to drop full names from frontline staff name tags

zh: 華航高雄飛高松包機啟航並擴增日韓航線
en: China Airlines launches Kaohsiung-Takamatsu charters and expands routes to Japan and South Korea

zh: BermudAir租賃首架E190F客改貨機，將成美洲首位營運商
en: BermudAir will lease an Embraer E190F to become its first operator in the Americas.

zh: 西捷航空合作Tim Hortons於機上提供特製咖啡
en: WestJet partners with Tim Hortons to introduce bespoke in-flight coffee.

zh: Honeywell 聯盟氫電推進系統整合成功，下一階段赴義大利地面示範
en: Honeywell alliance integrates hydrogen-electric propulsion; Italy ground demo next
